goal: Maximize probability of first independent, settled, fulfilled, attributable sale today; not a guarantee.
execution_order: Run scripts/VERIFY-FIRST-MONEY.ps1 read-only on the local PC and record current HTTP statuses, deployed commit, git state and exact LM Studio /v1/models IDs.
Find the earliest failed transition; do not create unpaid checkout sessions as smoke tests and do not self-purchase.
Repair the existing route/config only; no new infrastructure, SKU, ledger or database table.
Verify independent settlement, correct SKU/amount/currency, idempotent entitlement, scoped key, authenticated probe, attributable receipt and reconciliation.
Unhold the NZ$19 offer and distribute QR only after the paid probe and margin/safety gates pass.
Write a falsifiable receipt with timestamp, commit, evidence, blocker, next action and stop condition.

lm_studio_policy.model_inventory: Read actual local /v1/models response; never infer loaded models from installed models.
lm_studio_policy.pc_offline: No local worker execution claim when PC is off.

gates.supabase_persistence: UNVERIFIED until data-plane and persistence tests pass
gates.revenue_requires: independent buyer + settled payment + fulfillment + delivery evidence + attribution + reconciliation

close_criteria.minimum: fresh read-only production check; exact blocker or complete verified sale; regression result; receipt; repository/Notion/Airtable reconciliation
close_criteria.stretch: one independent buyer pays and receives the promised bounded probe today
